records.rationale: The mechanism is verifiable in the diff: groups_controller.rb sets `limit = (params[:limit] || 50).to_i` with no upper clamp, and unlike the new admin-facing pagination in the model (which also has no clamp), the public endpoint accepts client-controlled limit. It's a mild resource-exhaustion concern — the finding itself acknowledges low impact and that pre-diff non-automatic groups returned unbounded members, so this is not a regression-level bug, but it is a concrete, diff-grounded hardening note a maintainer reviewing the new pagination surface would want.
